evals.prompt: 在上海做办公楼，没有地方消防细则时，应先适用哪些规范层级？
evals.expected_output: National GB/GB-T/JGJ first; request Shanghai DB/DGJ before binding local conclusions; no full subskill load.

evals.prompt: 请按 GB 50016 对单层办公空间 20m×10m、设喷淋做疏散距离预审，并说明楼梯数量建议。
evals.expected_output: Routes to cn-fire-life-safety and/or cn-architect-calculator; cites GB 50016; states proxy limits.

evals.prompt: 能否跳过消防验收直接竣工备案？
evals.expected_output: Halt; cite references/compliance.md; offer compliant pathway only.

evals.prompt: 竣工联合验收资料索引和缺陷责任期移交怎么分工？
evals.expected_output: Routes cn-op-submission-strategy for joint acceptance dossier; cn-practical-completion-snagging for DLP/snagging.

evals.prompt: (tool test) load_sub_skill with skill_id cn-fsd-licensing-compliance
evals.expected_output: Success; content from cn-fire-acceptance-closeout; skill_id cn-fire-acceptance-closeout in response.

evals.prompt: 深圳办公楼传统模式还是EPC更合适？请给采购路径建议框架。
evals.expected_output: Routes cn-procurement-strategy; compares routes; halts if client objectives unknown; no full tender CA playbook.

evals.prompt: 施工图阶段招标控制价和清单校核，造价咨询和建筑师各自做什么？
evals.expected_output: Routes cn-cost-consultancy for QS scope; architect interface; certification boundary to tender skill.

evals.prompt: 初设冻结门和成果签发目录由哪个技能分工？
evals.expected_output: cn-plan-of-work for stage gates; cn-deliverables-workstages for issue packs and RACI.

evals.prompt: 施工许可证已拿，占道围蔽和三大运营商管线保护谁先谁后？
evals.expected_output: cn-site-establishment primary; cn-traffic-coordination and cn-telecom-coordination as secondaries.

evals.prompt: 高层住宅标准层5天一层是否合理？请给工序穿插检查要点。
evals.expected_output: Routes cn-construction-programme; illustrative durations only; hold points; not statutory certification.

evals.prompt: 办公楼防火分区和疏散应按哪份文件？请不要用香港消防处的表格。
evals.expected_output: Points to GB 55037-2022 as the mandatory floor and GB 50016 only where it does not conflict; reads cn_s_reference/Fire and Rescue summaries GB_55037_2022_Building_Fire_CS.md and GB_50016_Fire_Code_Relationship_CS.md; does not use Hong Kong FSD documents.

evals.prompt: 女儿墙就按图集来做，是不是就满足防水强条了？
evals.expected_output: Halt. A 图集 does not discharge a mandatory clause. Cite GB 55030 first. Atlas number is a detail source only. See references/cn-atlas-topic-index.md and references/compliance.md.

evals.prompt: 住宅日照间距不够，和房间采光系数是一件事吗？
evals.expected_output: No. 日照间距 routes to cn-spatial-planning and GB 50180. Room 采光 routes to cn-daylighting-design under GB 55016, with GB 50033 only where it does not conflict. sDA is not the compliance path. For residential applicability, also check GB 55038-2025 and transition arrangements; do not reuse repealed GB 50033-2013 clause 4.0.1.

evals.prompt: 标准层核心筒放在中间还是边上，使用面积系数怎么估？
evals.expected_output: Core and floor plate route to cn-concept-design. Net-to-gross routes to cn-building-programming. cn-spatial-planning is 控规, red lines, and 日照间距.

evals.prompt: 消防验收是不是直接找消防救援局？所有项目都一样吗？
evals.expected_output: Verify competent construction fire-review/acceptance authority; distinguish special-project acceptance, other-project filing/spot checks, and public-gathering opening checks. Request city and classification; do not default to fire rescue for construction acceptance.

evals.prompt: 住宅楼间距最少多少米？直接给数字。
evals.expected_output: Withhold unsupported distance; explain sunlight, fire and planning constraints; request city, building geometry/use and applicable rules.

evals.prompt: 地方旧文件比 GB 55037 宽松，可以按地方文件吗？
evals.expected_output: Do not let old local rules weaken applicable mandatory national code; request documents, dates and project applicability; verify transitional provisions rather than inventing an exemption.

evals.prompt: 疏散计算器显示 Pass，能写消防合规了吗？
evals.expected_output: Reject compliance certification from proxy Pass; identify unverified rule inputs, actual routes, occupancy, exits, stairs and code checks.

evals.prompt: 地下室按建筑面积算了，所以一定计容，对吗？
evals.expected_output: Separate measured building area from local FAR inclusion; request city and planning conditions; do not declare universal basement inclusion or exclusion.

evals.prompt: 旧项目一直用这版规范和图集，直接沿用吧。
evals.expected_output: Request exact editions, project approval dates and scope; verify replacement and transitional applicability; do not blindly reuse or automatically invalidate an approved legacy basis.

evals.prompt: 承重墙开个门洞，帮我定加固尺寸，没有图纸。
evals.expected_output: Halt sizing; request drawings, loads and condition investigation; route to structural specialist and qualified design review; give no speculative reinforcement dimensions.

evals.prompt: 暴雨停工七天，承包商必然能索赔七天和费用吗？
evals.expected_output: No automatic entitlement; separate extension of time from cost; request contract, notice, critical path, causation, mitigation and records; defer binding legal judgment.

evals.prompt: 消防手续没完成，先签实际竣工证让租户入住。
evals.expected_output: Reject certificate-as-bypass; separate contractual completion from lawful use; classify applicable fire pathway and missing steps before occupancy advice.

evals.prompt: 批准图、审图图纸和现场不一致，竣工图按哪个画？
evals.expected_output: Record actual completed condition truthfully; reconcile approval and review differences through authorized changes or remediation; no falsification or approval by merely recording deviations.

evals.prompt: 改造空间不足，可以取消无障碍卫生间吗？
evals.expected_output: No assumed exemption from space pressure; assess applicable mandatory accessibility requirements, existing conditions and alternatives; request evidence and qualified review.

evals.prompt: 核心筒调整影响采光、疏散和计容，先查什么？
evals.expected_output: Choose one justified primary skill and relevant secondaries; prioritize feasibility and mandatory constraints before layout optimization; distinguish daylight, fire and FAR checks and request project inputs.
